audit.why: Even lane at 51.46% over 888 games. Brand out-ranges Viktor (W 900 / Q 1050 vs Siphon Power 600, Hextech Ray 525) and owns levels 1-6; Viktor takes over once augments and items land.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named 'Chaos Storm' and 'Hex Core', and called Siphon Power an E.
audit.why: Riot's kit file gives Arcane Storm (R, 120/100/80), Siphon Power (Q, 9/8/7/6/5), and the passive is Glorious Evolution with Hex Fragments.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3] and whys[6] with the real names and cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Arcane Storm is a channel, nor that Siphon Power is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: enemyKit flags R as channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it) and Q as autoReset; an ablaze Sear stun therefore cancels his ultimate outright.
audit.corrected: Added the R-cancel interaction to report[5].t and dosFull[2].d; the Siphon Power shield/reset now drives dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Now carries Gravity Field 17s->13s, Sear 8s, Conflagration 13s, Pyroclasm 100s.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] claimed his E gets 'bonus true damage procs' inside Gravity Field.
audit.why: No true damage anywhere in Viktor's kit text; the real danger is the field's own stun on lingering.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E-Q stun package for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Gravity Field (W) is 17s at rank 1 and 13s maxed: outside it he has no lockdown, so step up the moment it expires. - Sear (Q) is 8s and Conflagration (E) 13s at rank 1 — bank both for his walk-up, and spend the 100s Pyroclasm on a commit, never on harassment.

edits.before: The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame lands after a delay at 900 range on an 8s cooldown maxed — aim where he must stand to last-hit, not where he is now.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Conflagration (E) is point-and-click inside 625 and applies Blaze on cast — ablaze first and Sear becomes a stun instead of a 70-mana ball.

edits.before: Viktor whiffs Gravity Field and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Ablaze first: Q stuns only a burning target, and that stun cancels his R.

edits.before: That is Viktor’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Unablazed, Sear (Q) is 70 mana and 8s for no stun at all.

edits.before: Your stun only exists on ablaze targets — a Q thrown at a clean health bar is the most expensive miss in your kit.
edits.after: With E on 13s at rank 1 and W on 10s, a whiffed rotation leaves you immobile at 900 range against a 600-range shield poke.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Siphon Power (Q) shields him every 9s at rank 1 and resets his auto — dumping the rotation into a fresh shield spends 13s of E for nothing.

edits.before: Track Viktor’s Gravity Field: The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Gravity Field (W), 17s at rank 1: linger in it and it stuns you. Arcane Storm (R) is a channel, so an ablaze Sear (Q) stun cancels it — bank Q for his ult.

edits.before: Viktor wins by landing Gravity Field, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Viktor wins by chaining Gravity Field into Hextech Ray, then scaling augments into an Arcane Storm late game.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by detonating Blaze on the clump Arcane Storm holds still — his own R herds them into your Pyroclasm bounces at 750 range.

edits.before: If Viktor opens the score, reset expectations and respect Gravity Field doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with W-E clears and stay relevant through stun-burn peel.
edits.after: If Viktor opens the score his Hex Fragments arrive sooner and Gravity Field's 13s cooldown covers more of the lane — farm with W-E from max range, never contest a wave standing inside the zone, and stay useful as stun-burn peel.

edits.before: Pillar of Flame chunks Viktor before his Siphon Power (E) shield-and-poke combo has the range or damage to match it, letting you dominate the wave.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame (W) at 900 range chunks Viktor before Siphon Power (Q) — a 600-range shield poke on 9s — has the reach to answer, so you own the wave.

edits.before: Your burst combo still edges out his Siphon Power poke damage at this stage, so you keep winning most extended trades.
edits.after: Your Liandry's rotation edges out Siphon Power (Q) chip: his shield covers one cast, not four seconds of Blaze ticking through it.

edits.before: Once Viktor completes his augment/Hex Core upgrades and has full item power, his Chaos Storm (R) plus scaling laser poke output starts exceeding your damage in a straight fight.
edits.after: Once Viktor has augmented his abilities with Hex Fragments and has full items, Arcane Storm (R) on an 80s cooldown plus Hextech Ray (E) poke starts exceeding your damage in a straight fight.

edits.before: 2+ items: his fully-scaled Hex Core kit and Chaos Storm finally out-damage you in a straight fight, flipping the late-game favor to Viktor.
edits.after: 2+ items: his augmented kit and Arcane Storm (R), 80s maxed, finally out-damage you in a straight fight, flipping the late game to Viktor.

edits.before: Poke him down early with Q before his Hex Core augments come online
edits.after: Poke with Pillar of Flame (W); Sear (Q) only stuns targets already ablaze

edits.before: Avoid standing in Gravity Field zones where his E gets bonus true damage procs
edits.after: Leave Gravity Field (W) fast — staying in the zone too long stuns you outright
